messages:
ana: Heads-up — I’m starting the onboarding for model-x v1.0 into the catalog. Quick checklist before I open the PR: weights location, tokenizer sanity, catalog config values (seq_len/quant), and regional gating + fallback. Weights are at s3://redwood-models/model-x/v1.0/ (sharded: model-000.pt..model-015.pt). Tokenizer files: model.spm + tokenizer.json in the same folder. Two potential problems I noticed locally: tokenizer.json doesn’t include <bos> mapping and the model was compiled for 4096 but catalog entry currently has max_seq_len: 2048. Planning a phased region enablement: start EU (eu-west-1) canary -> then US (us-west-2), fallback to model-x-lite. Anyone see blockers?

miguel: pinging eng-runtime/infra — @sam could you check the kv-cache layout compatibility and the kernel selection for 4k sequences on our current fp16 fpga builds? Also need the quantized 8bit artifacts uploaded to the same s3 prefix if possible.

sam: looking. quick note: the "compiled for 4096" is likely the block size used during compile-time. If model was compiled with rotary+4k patches we should be fine, but runtime config needs to set chunk_size=4096 and ensure attention kernels switch. I’ll run the compatibility tool now.

sam: ran the compatibility check: passes except for tokenizer header. The tokenizer.json missing <bos> means generation can sometimes drop initial token in chat mode. I can patch tokenizer.json to add "bos_token": "<s>" and map id 1 if that ID is free. Before I push, can someone confirm the canonical special token ids we want?

ana: prefer bos=1, eos=2, pad=0 (consistent with other catalog entries). If id 1 conflicts, we can remap in tokenizer.json but prefer stable mapping. Thanks for checking.

miguel: devex, any objections to us patching the tokenizer.json in-place in the s3 path? We can keep a digested copy and reference the pinned tokenizer version in the catalog entry.

devex: in-place is OK if you create a new key like tokenizer.json.v2 and update the catalog metadata to point to it (catalog entries must be immutable). Also add an entry to asset-manifest.json for provenance.

sam: done locally — added bos=1 and bumped tokenizer.json -> tokenizer.json.v2. Also updated catalog config to max_seq_len: 4096 and added variant entries: model-x-1.0-fp16, model-x-1.0-8bit and fallback: model-x-lite-0.9-8bit. Pushing PR now.

ana: thanks. PR link?

sam: https://github.com/redwood-inference/catalog/pull/4321 — description: "model-x v1.0 onboarding: tokenizer v2, seq_len=4096, variants + regional gating (eu -> us)."

miguel: quick sanity check for rollout YAML (example in PR):

```yaml
catalog_entry: model-x:1.0
enable_regions: [eu-west-1]
canary:
  percentage: 5
  route: "eu@subset-100"
fallback_variant: model-x-lite:0.9
variants:
  - name: model-x-1.0-fp16
  - name: model-x-1.0-8bit
  - name: model-x-lite-0.9-8bit
max_seq_len: 4096
```

miguel: LGTM w/ one ask — add a "rollback_route" that points to model-x-lite for the region to make immediate failover cheaper.

sam: will add rollback_route. Also uploaded quantized artifacts to s3://redwood-models/model-x/v1.0/q8/ and added checksum files.

deploy-bot: Canary kickoff triggered by miguel for catalog:model-x:1.0 in eu-west-1 -> route eu@subset-100. Instance group: dedicated-small-gpu.

sam: confirm: I validated the kv-cache layout, added the tokenizer.json.v2 to the asset-manifest, updated catalog entry in PR #4321 with rollback_route -> model-x-lite:0.9, and included region enable list. Unit tests for tokenization added (tokenizer_roundtrip_test).

devex: merged PR #4321 to staging catalog. Tagging @ana for release notes and @ops for scheduled canary.

miguel: scheduling canary ramp: start 2026-11-02T09:00:00Z (eu), monitor latency, memory, and output-churn metrics. If >= 3 regressions in the eval suite, auto rollback to model-x-lite:0.9.

ana: thanks all. small follow-up: please add a note in the PR about the BOS mapping decision (why id 1). Also, ensure the console shows token-level cost delta for 4k runs so product can approve cost change.

sam: added note and a small cost estimate doc in the PR. I also pinned the exact weights digest (sha256:abcdef...) in the catalog entry so rollout is deterministic.

deploy-bot: Canary succeeded (24h) in eu-west-1 with error rate <0.1% and latency within SLO. Promoting to us-west-2 scheduled: 2026-11-03T09:00:00Z.

miguel: perfect. final ask — archive the original tokenizer.json to S3 as tokenizer.json.v1.bak (for auditing). sam, can you do that before us rollout?

sam: done — archived tokenizer.json -> tokenizer.json.v1.bak, pushed tokenizer.json.v2 in place for the pinned digest path.

ana: all set from product. closing this thread. thanks everyone :tada:
